scripts.build: cd backend/medusa-app && npm install --include=dev && cd apps/backend && npm install --include=dev && npx @medusajs/cli build && cp -r .medusa ../../../medusa_built_bundle
scripts.start: cd backend/medusa-app/apps/backend && (cp -r ../../../medusa_built_bundle/. .medusa 2>/dev/null || true) && npx @medusajs/cli db:migrate && npx @medusajs/cli start
